lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Trainer!

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: We had a dog come into the shelter recently that looks just like you!
Really?

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Ah.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Are you talking about that big dog?

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: That's the one!

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: He's a big fella, with a personality to match, so he gets along well with Timi.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: I didn't really notice a resemblance before,

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: but now that you mention it...
Can you tell me more about him?

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: He's got a long, pointed muzzle,

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: slightly upturned eyes,

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: and perky ears that stick straight up.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: He's also got an unusual bark.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: It's waaaaaay lower than usual.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Instead of "woof woof",

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: it's more like a "hwwwaaah"

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Wow!

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Interesting.
Are you saying that's how I sound?

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Not really, just the overall feeling.
Soooo... I'm like a dog, is that it?

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: You really are!

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Um...

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Why'd everyone go quiet?

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Looking like a dog is a compliment!

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: No one ever takes being compared to a dog positively.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: With a puppy, maybe. But a dog? No way.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: But puppies are cute and cuddly.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Trainer is super cool.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: That may be true, but...
It's fine. I'm glad you meant it as a compliment.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Whoa, really?

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: I'll tell it to you more often, then.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Still... it's not really a thing you should be saying to people,

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: so try not to say it too often.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Okie dokie.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: You're lucky Scoops is so understanding.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: That he is.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: The next time you come by, we can show you your canine doppelganger.
I'm interested to see him for myself.
